qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Belron's insurer integrations and global scale drive consistent price and mix gains above inflation, particularly from rising ADAS camera/sensor recalibration attach rates on replacement windshields.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 6 (N, REJECT). While Belron (Carglass/Safelite) and TVH are exceptional, high-return operating assets, D'Ieteren fails Gate 6 due to massive leverage: late-2024 dividend recapitalizations saddled Belron with ~€9B in debt (rated BB-) to fund a €4B extraordinary dividend, driving D'Ieteren consolidated equity negative (-€457M in 2024) and look-through debt/Owner Earnings to ~8-10x.
qualitative.evidence: Consolidated balance sheet showed negative equity (-€456.9M) in FY2024 and thin equity (€14.3M) in FY2025 following the €74/share special dividend. Equity-accounted Belron incurred €3.8B in incremental debt, bringing net debt to ~€9B. Look-through debt/Owner Earnings exceeds the <=4.0x threshold by more than double.

evaluation_metadata.verdict: Rejected – G6 Cash & Fortress Balance Sheet
